tabTrail.name: Sign in to save across devices

notes: Signature loader states observed across the 45 navigations: done, playing, late-hydration. A cold context is used per sample, so a show is a cold tab and a skip is the component's own guard.
Third-party hosts are aborted, so font and media CDN bytes are absent from every figure. Transfer sizes are therefore first-party only.

Desktop and mobile run unthrottled on loopback; the slow condition uses Lighthouse Fast 3G values (150ms RTT, 1.6 Mbps down, 750 kbps up) plus a 4x CPU slowdown. Loopback removes internet RTT from the server side, so ttfb here is a floor, not a field number.

The ready selector per route is what a visitor must see to act: a heading on landing, creator and book, a Look card on discover, and the document body on a Look page. It is a usability mark, not a paint metric.
conditionsText: Windows, installed Chrome headless, next start production build, owned loopback PostgreSQL 17.11 disposable cluster, one seeded professional workspace with one published Look and one service, no route interception, third-party hosts aborted.
